## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a handsome young lady known for her showy looks, which include a brilliant complexion, golden hair worn in a long braid or flowing, and large, bright-blue eyes. She originally possessed a plump figure, though she later became very thin, with delicate, almost transparent hands and eyes that appeared overly bright and lustrous.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Personality

Cheerful and good-tempered, she candidly enjoys life's simple pleasures, though she can be sentimental and is prone to hysterics. Her mind is heavily focused on young men, and she aspires to have numerous suitors and enjoy a lively time before eventually marrying after a brief two-year teaching career. Additionally, she harbors a dread of caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many big sisters and once used a magic pebble to charm away her warts. During her school days, she formed a [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). Ruby expressed a childhood wish to have dozens of beaus when she grew up, and she visited [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) the fall before falling ill. During Anne's time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Ruby sent updates from home in a bundle of letters. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she learned that Ruby was terminally ill with consumption, even though Ruby stubbornly insisted she was healthy during a visit at her home. Later, Ruby tearfully confessed her fear of dying to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during an evening together, but she passed away peacefully in her sleep the following night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), +10 more_

## Quotes

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)

> "Me! Why, I’m perfectly well. I never felt better in my life. Of course, that congestion last winter pulled me down a little. But just see my color. I don’t look much like an invalid, I’m sure."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I’ll try. I’ll think over what you have said, and try to believe it. And you’ll come up as often as you can, won’t you, Anne?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

> “Nor I,” said Ruby Gillis, with a shiver. “I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright.”
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)
